description: Dr. Christoph Guger is founder of g.Tec, a company that focuses on creating devices and parts for the field of brain-machine interface. In this particular interview, Christoph shares with us the direction and progress of brain-machine interface, as well as explaining the concept of "embodiment," where a person truly "feels" that a device controlled by their thoughts is a part of themselves, and extension of themselves. Where might these technologies make their jump into the mainstream? Listen to…
classificationReason: Interview focuses on brain-machine interfaces, embodied control, and robotic limbs.
qualityReason: Named founder interview with a technical discussion of the field and embodiment.
